license_required.quote: An individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice podiatry in this State.

issuing_authority.value: State Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners.

age_minimum.quote: The applicant shall be at least 18 years old.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good moral character.

degree_required.value: graduate of a school or college of podiatric medicine
degree_required.quote: The applicant shall be a graduate of a school or college of podiatric medicine that is accredited by the Council on Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association and approved by the Board.

accrediting_body.value: Council on Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the Council on Education of the American Podiatric Medical Association and approved by the Board

required.quote: The Board may require an applicant to complete a postgraduate podiatric residency program

kind.quote: The Board may require an applicant to complete a postgraduate podiatric residency program

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners licensing examination
exams.quote: The National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners licensing examination

exams.name: Written examination on the Board's statute and regulations
exams.quote: A written examination on the Board's statute and regulations administered by the Board under § 16–304 of this subtitle.

interval_years.quote: A license may not be renewed for a term longer than 2 years.

required.quote: The Board may establish continuing education requirements as a condition to the renewal of licenses under this section.

available.quote: The Board may issue a temporary license to a podiatrist licensed in another state to practice or teach podiatry in this State if: (1) The license issued from the other state has licensing requirements equivalent to those in this State

requirements.value: License from other state must have licensing requirements equivalent to those in Maryland; applicant pays temporary license fee
requirements.quote: The license issued from the other state has licensing requirements equivalent to those in this State; and (2) The licensed podiatrist pays a temporary license fee as determined by the Board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice podiatry" means to diagnose or surgically, medically, or mechanically treat the human foot or ankle, the anatomical structures that attach to the human foot, or the soft tissue below the mid–calf.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice podiatry" means to diagnose or surgically, medically, or mechanically treat the human foot or ankle, the anatomical structures that attach to the human foot, or the soft tissue below the mid–calf.

methods_authorized.quote: to diagnose or surgically, medically, or mechanically treat the human foot or ankle

drug_authority.value: Board may adopt rules and regulations regarding the dispensing of prescription drugs by a licensed podiatrist
drug_authority.quote: After consulting with the State Board of Pharmacy, adopt rules and regulations regarding the dispensing of prescription drugs by a licensed podiatrist

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the human foot or ankle, the anatomical structures that attach to the human foot, or the soft tissue below the mid–calf

anesthesia_authority.quote: "Practice podiatry" does not include administration of an anesthetic, other than a local anesthetic.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: All osseous surgical procedures of the ankle, arthrodeses of 2 or more tarsal bones, and complete tarsal osteotomies that are performed by a licensed podiatrist shall be performed in a licensed hospital or ambulatory surgical center

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: Have current surgical privileges at a licensed hospital for the same procedure

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: shall be performed in a licensed hospital or ambulatory surgical center

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: This title does not affect the commercial sale or fitting of shoes or foot appliances.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: a podiatrist rehabilitation committee evaluates and provides assistance to any podiatrist, and any other individual regulated by the Board, in need of treatment and rehabilitation for alcoholism, drug abuse, chemical dependency, or other physical, emotional, or mental condition.
